Remark
[horizontal and mixed curvature formulas]

Source: petersen:page-0172 ↗ rem:pet-ch4-ex-7 ↗ thm:pet-ch4-oneill-formula 1. ch4:4.7.8Using the $A,T$-tensors of section 6, show $\bar R(\bar Y,\bar X,\bar X,\bar Y)=R(Y,X,X,Y)-3|A_{\bar X}\bar Y|^2$ and $\bar R(V,\bar X,\bar X,V)=\bar g\big((\nabla _{\bar X}T)_V,\bar X\big)+|A_{\bar X}V|^2-|T_V\bar X|^2$; compare the second formula to the radial curvature equation.
